method: one evidence-driven candidate at a time from the fixed baseline

baseline.implication: one-shard migration recovery was tractable for the target agent

iterations.change: atomic one-to-many shard split with live transactional and snapshot obligations
atomic conditional transactions with read-only guard participants
atomic multi-shard placement plans across reusable workers while prior obligations remain live
iterations.shared_failure_pattern: completed read responsibility survives ownership changes and incorrectly forces a later healthy transaction to abort
